roster.name: Artemis I
roster.note: an uncrewed Orion flies around the Moon on the first SLS launch — the deep-space hardware is proven before anyone rides it
the first crew — four astronauts, including the first non-American to fly to the Moon, on a lunar flyby
the return to the surface — the first crewed lunar landing since 1972, and the first ever near the south pole, using a Starship lander
the first mission to the Gateway — the small international station being assembled in lunar orbit
